description: Learn how to take care of yourself by standardizing the operations 🥂 #selflove #confidence #leadershipskills
transcript: You have all the tools and the resources to keep your nervous system regulated. You have to know your rules, your procedures, and your policies for different situations. Create an SOP for your life. Create a vision for your life. Create a mission. Understand the way in which you operate. You are the only thing that can keep you regulated. You cannot depend on the external world to regulate you.
